facts.value: As part of your program in our Department of Economics, you can complete certain modules in other departments, referred to as import modules from other departments - including optional modules. This is only based on existing cooperation agreements between the departments.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: For the programs of the Department of Economics, an overview has been compiled detailing which import modules you can register for in other departments and how to integrate these import modules into your program in the Department of Economics.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Furthermore, you cannot integrate any other modules from other departments into your program in the Department of Economics and cannot earn differing Credit Points (CP).
